correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and normalizations reconstructed. Exact block-Gram eigenvalues show rank n-1 and its stated null vector for every n>=4 and r>0. The differentiable simple zero eigenvalue yields the correct tangent halfspace in independent off-diagonal Euclidean coordinates. Metric projection onto tangent limits proves actual finite-pair Lipschitz lower bounds, not just linearized experiments. Compactness at both scaling tails and a unique scalar maximizer yield the asymptotic family coefficient (2-sqrt(2))/4. Firm nonexpansivity gives the independent order-n upper bound. Standalone checker passes 161 rational instances; not used as a substitute for infinite proof.

value.rationale: Establishes the growth order Theta(n) of a natural, dimension-dependent robustness invariant for nearest correlation matrix repair. A rank n-1 two-population construction yields a nontrivial analytic leading lower-bound constant for the supremum of coordinatewise amplification. The needed exact face geometry has a direct role in explaining instability of numerical correlation repair, independent of any global sharp-prefactor claim.
